name: ARMOR-STUDIO
deployment_target: Browser console served by its own static host or by the nginx of the container image
evidence_record: Used by the maintainer on a real installation (CM5 test bench with the real server, real IP cameras and a real radar node); the parts that were not tried on real hardware are listed in the README.
build: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
notes: Operational browser dashboard for the A.R.M.O.R. server API. Studio keeps no password, token or session in the browser; it keeps, per server, the drawings, the camera names and addresses and the preferences.
